content: Amasías, Judá-yar-sesad
Amasías birga-dulagwen-gakatar-nikadgi (25) yar sealid. Jerusalén-neggweburgi birga-dulagwen-gakabakebak (29) yar sesad. E-nan. Joadánʼye nugad, Jerusalénʼginedid.
Amasías, Bab-Jehová-asabin ibmar-nueganbi imaksad. Degi-inigwele, gwage-ulubgi innikigwadba Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-imaksasulid.
Amasías nue-yar-semai-guargua, dummagan-e-bab-gindaksamalad bela oburgwisad.

Degi-inigwele, Amasías. Bab-Jehová-sogsa-gusadbali dummagan-e-masmaladi oburgwissulid. Ar ade, Moisés-gardagi Bab-Jehová-sogsad narmakar maid: “Babgan mimmigan-ulale burgosurye, degi, mimmigan babgan-ular burgosurmoye. Dule war-wargwen na e-isgued-ular burgwemaloye.”

content.text: Geb degine, Amasías, dule-birga-durgwen-nikmalad-nug (20), degi, obine-nikamalad-nug wesad.
Daklealid, mili-dulataled-ilapaa (300,000) sordamar guagwar bila-ononaega gudii.
Wemar bato eswar-mied wismalad, degi, sigu-abgaed-ebuleged wismarbalid.

content: Deginbali, Amasías, Israel-sorda-mili-dulatar-mergue (100,000) amisad. Amasías a-sordamar, mani nibir-miligugle gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulapaa-aidikue-wilub (7,260) baksad.
Geb Bab-Dummad-e-dule Rey-Amasíasʼse nonigusad, ega sognonikid: —Rey-Amasías, mer Israel-sordamar beba be nido. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová, Israel-sordamarba, degi, Efraín-dulemarba naisulid.

Degi, gines amar-abargi gandikidba be bila-ononaye sogele, Bab-Dummad be-isdarmalad-asabin be-ogalakuoed. Ar ade, Bab-Dummad dule-bendakega gargangued-nikad, degine, dule-ogalakuega gargangued nikabalid.

Amasías, Bab-Jehová-e-dulese egichided: —Degite, ¿igi we guosunna Israel-sordamar mani nibir-miligugle gaka dulataled-ilabo gaka dulapaa (7,260) an bennuksad? Bab-Jehová-e-dule abin-sogded: —Be we-mani-uksadba Bab-Jehová bur bule bega ukoed.

Degidgi, Amasías, Israel-sorda eba-bila-onogedse-naega Efraín-yargi-danimaladi obesad, e-neg-e-negse namalagar. A-sordamar bela-bela Judá-dulemargi sae-itosmalad, degi, nabir-gwen-itossuli e-neg-e-negse gannar nadmalad.
Amasías nue gangusa, e-sorda-bila-onomalad Balu-Neba-naidse sesad. Agi, Seir-sorda-miliambe (10,000) osulosad.

Deginbali, Judá-sordamar, Seir-sorda-baigan-miliambe (10,000) gasmarbalid. A-sordamar ibe-matusulid-birise sesmalad. A-birigi-bukwa, Judá-sordamar Seir-sorda-obatismalad, degi, bela gar-bibisgar burgwismalad.

Deyob neg-gunagua, Amasías-Israel-sordamar-bila-onogedse-nissurmaladi, Judá-yargi igarba neggweburmar-bukwadgi ubodapmalad. Agi, wemar Samaria-neggwebur-akale, Bet-Horón-neggweburse, milipaa (3,000) dulemar-ogilosad. Degine, e-ibmar-nuegan-bukidar e-ibe susmarbalid.
Amasías, Edom-dulemar-ogilodiid-aibiris-nonigua, Seir-dulemar-e-nuchumar sealid, geb e-bab-dummaganga imaksad. Amasías a-bab-dummagan-e-nug odummosad, ega ina-wawadikid ogumaksabalid.

A-ulale, Bab-Jehová Rey-Amasíasʼgi uluded, degi, e-gayaburba-barsoged ega barmialid, ega sogega: —Amasías, Seir-bab-dummagan be-bila-onosadgi e-dulamar gwen bendaksasulid. Degite, ¿ibiga be a-e-nugmar be odummosa?

Geb Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged amba sunmakgwichidgine, Rey-Amasías egi gaya-egwannonikid, ega sogded: —Mer be sunmake. ¿Doa reyga-binsaed-dakega be-onug-imaksa? ¿Dule be-oburgwebi be abege? Geb Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged berguedgine ega sogded: —An wisid, ar weyob be ibmar-imaksad-ulale, degi, an-binsaedba be dabisulidbali, Bab-Dummad be-obelogoed.

Degi-inigwele, Judá-rey-Amasías, dule-baiganse binsaed-galesad-sorba, Israel-e-reyga e-gayaburba-berbemalad barmisad. Israel-rey-Joásʼde, Joacaz-e-machid, Jehú-e-wagwad. Amasías, Rey-Joásʼga weyob sogsiid: “Be wese dagmala, anmar anbo bila-onoge.”

Degidgine, Israel-rey-Joás, Judá-rey-Amasías-abin-imaksa gusad, ega weyob sogsiid: “Dutu-ikobiid-Líbano-yargi-nikad urwar-gwichidga gayaburba barmis gusad: ‘Be-sisgwa an-machiga be uke.’ Geb degi, Líbano-yargi ibmar-durgan-sapurbalid a-dutu-iko-nikadse nonigu, egi annasad, degi, obelosad.

Emide, be soged: ‘An Edom-dulemar-ogalakusye.’ Aga, be san-dummarba itoged, bur bule be san-dummarba imaked. Degi-inigwele, bur-nuedid be-neggi be gudii saed. ¿Ibiga na-be-dukin-berguegala boni be amibie, degi, Judá-dulemarga be boni amibibali?”
Degi-inigwele, Amasías, Edom-bab-dummagan-nug-odummodii gusad-ulale, Bab-Dummad Amasías-isdarmaladga Amasías-urmaksad. A-ulale, Amasías, Joás-itossurgusad.
Degidgine, Israel-rey-Joás, Amasíasʼbo-bila-onogega, Judá-yargi Bet-Semes-neggwebur-siidse nadsunnad.
Judá-sordamar, Israel-sordamarse galakusad. Degi, bela Judá-sordamar e-neg-e-negse duurmakdemarsunnad.

Israel-rey-Joás, Bet-Semes-neggweburgi Judá-rey-Amasías-ganonikid. Amasíasʼde, Joás-machid, Joacaz-wagwad. Geb Joás, Jerusalénʼse Amasías-sesad. Agi, Rey-Joás neggwebur-galu-egaega dali-dulatar-sugue (100) omukusad. A-galu, Efraín-Yawagak-gwichid-akale, Neg-Sukun-Yawagak-gwichidsega egasad.

A-ukinbali, Rey-Joás, ormar, manimar, degi, bela Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yagi ibmar-ebulemalad-amilesadi susbalid. A-ibmarmala Obed-Edom akwediid. Deginbali, ibmar-nuegan-gargerbamalad reyneggi-amilesadi sesbalid. Degine, dule-dummagan-e-mimmigan-gasa sesbalid. Geb Joás, gannar Samaria-neggweburse nonikid.
Joás-machi-Judá-rey-Amasías, Joacaz-machi-Israel-rey-Joás-burgwisad-sorba, birgambe-gakatar (15) napi-gudii gusad.
Rey-Amasías ibmar-baigan imaksabalid. Gebesaila-ibmar-imakded, bela berguedsega ibmar-imaksadi, Judá-e-reymar-gardagi, degi, Israel-e-reymar-gardagi narmakar mamaid.

Amasías, Bab-Jehováʼgi bangudgua, Jerusalénʼginmalad egi isdar binsadmalad. Degidbali, Amasías Laquis-neggweburse wakite gusad. Degi-inigwele, dulemar a-neggweburse balegicha gusmalad. Geb Laquisʼgi, Amasías-oburgwismalad.
Degi, Amasías-mui moligi searmalad. Geb Judá-neggweburgi e-babgan-digar-mamaidgi digsamalad.
